title: Potion of Sleep
summary: Sleep for 3 turns when drunk, or throw to put nearby creatures to sleep.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action on yourself. Sleeping for 3 turns.
fields.Throw: Action, up to 60 ft. Sleeping for 3 turns in a 3 ft radius.
fields.Sleeping: Cannot move or act. Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saves. Attacks against the sleeper have advantage and hits from within 5 ft critically hit. Damage, Wet, Help, or Shove ends the condition.
fields.Acquisition: Found in the Blighted Village apothecary, on Priestess Gut, in the House of Healing, or at Sorcerous Sundries. No Alchemy recipe.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
